title: RTPO: Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization for Stabilizing Agentic RL Training
abstract: Training multi-turn agentic workflows with reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models to perform complex reasoning, use external tools, and conduct iterative search beyond single-turn settings. Yet multi-turn RL training remains highly unstable, often causing severe performance degradation as the number of turns increases. Through theoretical analysis, we identify three tightly coupled sources of instability: rollout-training context mismatch, weak turn-level credit assignment under sparse terminal rewards, and asynchronous policy drift when short and long trajectories are optimized under different policy versions. We show that these issues share a common structural origin in flattened trajectory optimization and address them through a unified reverse-turn formulation. We propose Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization (RTPO), which organizes multi-turn rollouts as sparse reverse trees and performs turn-level policy updates in temporal reverse order, aligning each decision with its downstream continuation. RTPO enables causally consistent turn-level credit assignment and on-policy continuation to control asynchronous drift. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that RTPO eliminates context mismatch and asynchronous drift under the proposed turn-level formulation, reduces credit bias, and converges to recursive optimality. Experiments on multi-turn agentic RL benchmarks show that RTPO improves upon trajectory- and turn-level baselines by 21.50% and 10.76%, respectively, highlighting its potential to support more stable training for tool-using agents.

analysis.ideaZh: RTPO 把 multi-turn agent RL 拆成 turn-boundary MDP，保存 rollout 的 exact visible context，以 reverse-order sparse sibling trees 做 state-matched credit，并用 current downstream policy 重新 continuation；作者报告 Qwen3-8B 八项 tool-use benchmark overall 61.66，GRPO/SeeUPO 为 53.71/57.68，但训练 GPU-hours 高约 41.3%、理论全局保证只在 tabular fixed-policy 条件成立，值得精读结构同时严看成本。
methodFlow: 把 multi-turn episode 表述为 turn-boundary MDP 并记录 exact rollout context
从 trunk 的每个 turn boundary fork sparse sibling rollouts
同状态 sibling returns 形成 turn-level group advantage
从最后一 turn 向前只更新当前 turn output tokens
用已更新 downstream policy on-policy continuation 规避 stale drift
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它是 multi-turn tool-agent RL 的结构性训练方案，可迁移到需要 visual feedback 的 design agents，即使当前实验本身不含视觉设计。
analysis.evidenceZh: RTPO 在 same boundary state 生成 siblings、反向逐 turn 优化，并只给当前 turn tokens 分配 advantage。（Sec. 3.1–3.3, Fig. 2, pp. 4–8）；作者报告八项 benchmark overall 61.66，GRPO 53.71，SeeUPO 57.68；RTPO 在八项均为最高或并列最高。（Sec. 4.1, Table 1, p. 8）；controlled credit experiment 中 RTPO-CA overall Pass@1/Pass@4 为 79.13/86.55，并在三个长搜索 benchmark 上优于 off-policy continuation。（Sec. 4.3–4.4, Tables 2–3, pp. 9–10）；作者明确承认 single-trunk dependence、K-phase overhead、downstream token under-utilization；补充实验还报告 G=3 比 GRPO GPU-hours 高约 41.3%。（Appendix F.4 and G.9, pp. 42 and 49–50）
analysis.caveatZh: 依赖单个 trunk quality，poor early state 会让后续 sibling advantages 接近零。；reverse K phases、policy sync 与 on-policy continuation 增加延迟，并丢弃 trunk/prefix/downstream tokens 的训练利用。；tabular fixed-downstream convergence 不自动扩展到 shared non-convex neural policy。；作者报告 G=3 的 wall-clock/GPU-hours 比 GRPO 高约 41.3%，G=4 generation tokens 高约 152.8%，性能提升伴随显著成本。；Airline sparse reward 的 zero-advantage rate 仍超过 80%，且 online success 在 step 40→50 从 56.25% 降至 40.63%。；只覆盖 Qwen3-4B/8B、3-turn math 和 6-turn search；tool-call 统计在 knowledge tasks 上 RTPO 反而更高。
analysis.motivationZh: 论文把 flattened trajectory 的 instability 归因于 rollout–training context mismatch、cross-state trajectory credit contamination 和 asynchronous downstream policy drift。RTPO 在每个 turn 保存同一 conditioning context，只对该 turn output tokens 更新；从 trunk boundary fork G−1 siblings 估计 local group advantage，并从末 turn 向前训练，每阶段用已更新 policy 继续采样到终点。理论给出 tabular recursive optimality/local unbiasedness，实验覆盖数学 Python tools 与 knowledge web search。
analysis.methodZh: 贡献不只是 reverse order，而是把 context identity、state-matched sibling credit 和 on-policy downstream continuation 统一为一套 turn-level PPO formulation；相较 GRPO、SeeUPO、ARPO/TreeGRPO，它同时针对三个结构性失配。 方法流程：把 multi-turn episode 表述为 turn-boundary MDP 并记录 exact rollout context → 从 trunk 的每个 turn boundary fork sparse sibling rollouts → 同状态 sibling returns 形成 turn-level group advantage → 从最后一 turn 向前只更新当前 turn output tokens → 用已更新 downstream policy on-policy continuation 规避 stale drift。
analysis.experimentsZh: 主实验以 Qwen3-8B 和 8×A100 80GB 运行 12 个 mathematical/knowledge experiments，比较 Vanilla、GRPO、SeeUPO，并在 controlled credit 中加入 ARPO/TreeGRPO；global rollout budget 固定为 math 80k、knowledge 16k，另测试 Qwen3-4B、deep-search on/off-policy variants 和 Airline online environment。 作者报告主表 RTPO overall 61.66，相对 GRPO 53.71 和 SeeUPO 57.68；AIME24 为 33.33 vs 10.00/20.00。（Table 1, p. 8） 作者报告 RTPO rollout/train logprob ratio 保持 1.0，而 knowledge task 的 SeeUPO/GRPO 约从 0.80 恢复到 0.89/0.83。（Fig. 3, p. 9） Baseline coverage：主表有 trajectory 与 turn-level baseline，controlled studies 进一步比较 ARPO/TreeGRPO；但不同方法的 rollout reuse、tool-call counts 和 wall-clock cost不等价，overall 还混合 Pass@1 与 F1。 Ablation：context consistency、turn-level credit、on/off-policy continuation、sibling group size、tool usage 与 Airline online dynamics 均有分析；没有证明 shared neural policy 的全局 convergence，且大规模/更长 turn 稳定性未覆盖。
analysis.insightZh: 收录并精读：三类失配的统一形式化、controlled analyses 和明确成本披露很有研究价值；是否成为 landmark 取决于更大模型、更长 turn 与等算力复现。 RTPO 把 multi-turn agent RL 拆成 turn-boundary MDP，保存 rollout 的 exact visible context，以 reverse-order sparse sibling trees 做 state-matched credit，并用 current downstream policy 重新 continuation；作者报告 Qwen3-8B 八项 tool-use benchmark overall 61.66，GRPO/SeeUPO 为 53.71/57.68，但训练 GPU-hours 高约 41.3%、理论全局保证只在 tabular fixed-policy 条件成立，值得精读结构同时严看成本。
